text:
You have power over your mind -
not outside events.
Realize this, and you will find strength.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text:
We suffer more often in imagination
than in reality.
author: Seneca

text:
Wealth consists not in having great possessions,
but in having few wants.
author: Epictetus

text:
Difficulties strengthen the mind,
as labor does the body.
author: Seneca

text:
He who has a why to live for
can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text:
In the depth of winter,
I finally learned that within me
there lay an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus

text:
The ability to observe without evaluating
is the highest form of intelligence.
author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

text:
The only way to make sense out of change
is to plunge into it, move with it,
and join the dance.
author: Alan Watts

text:
Deep work is the superpower
of the 21st century.
author: Cal Newport

text:
If you can't decide,
the answer is no.
author: Naval Ravikant

text:
The best way to do great work
is to find something you like doing,
and then do it.
author: Paul Graham

text:
Impatience with actions,
patience with results.
author: Naval Ravikant

text: Audentes fortuna iuvat.
author: Classical Latin Proverb

text: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः।
author: Sanskrit Proverb
transliteration: Udyamena hi sidhyanti kaaryaani na manorathaih.
translation: Work is completed by effort, not by mere wishing.

text: The obstacle is the path.
author: Zen Buddhist Koan

text:
Sitting quietly, doing nothing,
spring comes, and the grass grows by itself.
author: Zen Buddhist Koan

text:
काल करे सो आज कर, आज करे सो अब।
पल में प्रलय होएगी, बहुरी करेगा कब॥
author: Kabir
transliteration: Kaal kare so aaj kar, aaj kare so ab. Pal mein pralay hoegi, bahuri karega kab.
translation: Do tomorrow's work today, and today's work now. If the moment is lost, when will you do it?

text:
हज़ारों ख़्वाहिशें ऐसी कि हर ख़्वाहिश पे दम निकले।
बहुत निकले मिरे अरमान लेकिन फिर भी कम निकले॥
author: Mirza Ghalib
transliteration: Hazaaron khwaahishein aisi ki har khwaahish pe dam nikle. Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam निकले.
translation: Thousands of desires, each worth dying for. Many of my dreams were realized, yet they feel so few.

text:
रहिमन धागा प्रेम का, मत तोड़ो चटकाय।
टूटे से फिर ना मिले, मिले गाँठ परि जाय॥
author: Rahim
transliteration: Rahiman dhaaga prem ka, mat todo chatkaay. Toote se phir na mile, mile gaanth pari jaay.
translation: Do not snap the delicate thread of love. Once broken it cannot be joined; if joined, a knot remains.

text:
पोथी पढ़ि पढ़ि जग मुआ, पंडित भया न कोय।
ढाई आखर प्रेम का, पढ़े सो पंडित होय॥
author: Kabir
transliteration: Pothi padhi padhi jag mua, pandit bhaya na koy. Dhaai aakhar prem ka, padhe so pandit hoy.
translation: Reading books, the world died, yet none became wise. The one who reads two and a half letters of love becomes wise.

text:
The first principle is that you must not fool yourself,
and you are the easiest person to fool.
author: Richard Feynman

text:
Your time is limited,
so don't waste it living someone else's life.
author: Steve Jobs

text:
Nothing in life is to be feared,
it is only to be understood.
Now is the time to understand more.
author: Marie Curie

text:
If something is important enough,
you should do it even if the odds
are not in your favor.
author: Elon Musk
